name: IJM Allianz Duo Highway Challenge 2026
short_description: IJM Allianz Duo Highway Challenge 2026 is a verified Half/10K/5K race on a closed highway in Subang Jaya, Malaysia, confirmed for 2 August 2026.
ai_summary: IJM Allianz Duo Highway Challenge 2026 is a highway-closure road race on the NPE Highway in Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia, confirmed for 2 August 2026. Organized by IJM Corporation and Allianz, it offers Half Marathon, 10km, and 5km distances. As of the last verification on 16 July 2026, no registration link or pricing had been published, though the event's official website, a regional race aggregator, and an active Facebook page (10.2K followers) all confirm it is going ahead.

research_highlights: 2026 edition (8th edition) is a World Athletics/AIMS-certified course run across two fully closed highways: New Pantai Expressway (NPE/E10) and Besraya (E9), starting/finishing at Sunway Pyramid.
Four distances offered: 5KM, 10KM, 21KM (Half Marathon) and 42.195KM (Full Marathon), with organizers targeting around 15,000 participants for 2026.

Full marathon flag-off is very early (around 3am) with half marathon runners required at the start line before 5:30am and 10K starting an hour later, reflecting the pre-dawn timing typical of highway closures in Malaysia.
Race pack collection for the 2026 edition is at Sunway Pyramid Convention Centre (Level CP3), held on the Friday and Saturday before race day.

The NPE and Besraya highways are fully closed to vehicle traffic overnight and into race morning (from 11pm the night before until around 10am on race day), and the Sunway area gets congested with runners' parked cars on race morning.
research_watchouts: The very early flag-off times (3am for the full marathon) mean runners need to plan travel/sleep and parking well in advance.
Parking around Sunway Pyramid is reported to get congested on race morning due to the volume of runners' cars in the area.

One returning runner's account is largely about logistics and organisation rather than course scenery or crowd support, so first-hand accounts of on-course atmosphere or spectator crowds are limited in what's publicly available.

faqs.question: When is the IJM Allianz Duo Highway Challenge 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is confirmed for 2 August 2026 on the NPE Highway in Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. It was verified across the official event website, a regional race aggregator, and the organizer's active Facebook page as of 16 July 2026, giving it a solid confidence rating despite registration details not yet being public.

faqs.question: What makes the IJM Allianz Duo Highway Challenge different from other half marathons?
faqs.answer: The race runs on the NPE Highway itself, closed to traffic for the event, rather than typical city streets. It's organized by IJM Corporation together with Allianz and offers three distances -- Half Marathon, 10km, and 5km -- without a full marathon option, making it a dedicated shorter-distance highway event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the IJM Allianz Duo Highway Challenge?
faqs.answer: As of the last verification on 16 July 2026, no registration link or entry pricing had been published for this race. Runners interested in taking part should monitor the official website directly for registration announcements closer to the 2 August 2026 event date.
